title: Your First Weekend at Brown University, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Process Through the Gates
cards.subtitle: The Official Start of Your Brown Journey
cards.notes: Walk through the center gates as they open inward for Convocation. This tradition marks your official entry into the Brown community; you only pass through again at graduation.
cards.short_summary: The iconic gates that open only for Convocation and Commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: The center gates remain closed except for two occasions: they are opened inward to welcome first-year students during Opening Convocation and outward at Commencement.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public for viewing; center gates only open for specific university ceremonies.

cards.title: Join the Campus Game Night
cards.subtitle: Evening Social on the Historic Lawn
cards.notes: Head to the Main Green on Saturday night for board games and casual conversation. It is a central hub for meeting fellow first-years in a low-pressure outdoor setting.
cards.short_summary: The central lawn of Brown's campus and a primary social gathering spot.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Game Night is held on the Main Green during Orientation weekend, featuring board games and conversations with student representatives.
cards.access_notes: Orientation events typically require an NSO lanyard for entry; the Green itself is public.

cards.title: Grab a Muffin at the Blue Room
cards.subtitle: A Morning Ritual in Faunce House
cards.notes: Visit this campus staple in the Stephen Robert '62 Campus Center. It is famous for its muffins and sandwiches, serving as a popular weekend morning meeting spot.
cards.short_summary: A beloved campus cafe located in the Stephen Robert '62 Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Room is a retail cafe in the Campus Center known for its deli, muffins, and weekend hours from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Blue Room Cafe | Dining | Brown University
cards.access_notes: Open weekends 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM during the academic year.

cards.title: Walk the Thayer Street Corridor
cards.subtitle: The Heart of Student Commerce
cards.notes: Explore the shops and eateries lining this vibrant street. From the Brown Bookstore to local favorites like East Side Pockets, it is the go-to for off-campus essentials.
cards.short_summary: The main commercial street adjacent to Brown's campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Thayer Street is a vibrant area with dozens of unique businesses catering to the college crowd, including dining and shopping.
cards.source_title: Thayer Street Providence | Dining, Shopping, Local Culture
cards.access_notes: Public street; individual business hours vary.

cards.title: Browse the Galleries for Free
cards.subtitle: World-Class Art with Your Brown ID
cards.notes: Use your Brown ID for free admission to this renowned museum. It is a quiet weekend escape featuring everything from ancient Egyptian artifacts to contemporary design.
cards.short_summary: The art museum of the Rhode Island School of Design, accessible to Brown students.
cards.evidence_claim: Brown students receive free admission to the RISD Museum with a valid Brown ID through the Brown Arts Pass program.
cards.access_notes: Free for Brown students with ID; open Tuesday-Sunday 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM.

cards.title: Watch the Sunset Over Providence
cards.subtitle: A Scenic View of the City Skyline
cards.notes: Walk a few blocks from campus to see the statue of Roger Williams and enjoy the best view of downtown. It is a classic spot for students to gather at dusk.
cards.short_summary: An elevated park offering panoramic views of the Providence skyline.
cards.evidence_claim: Prospect Terrace is a student paradise for gathering and the perfect vantage point for sunsets over the city.
cards.source_title: View from the Top | Hey Rhody Media Co.
cards.access_notes: Public park; open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Visit the Fitness Loft
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Wellness on Hope Street
cards.notes: Check out the 10,000-square-foot fitness loft to stay active. It is the primary gym for students and offers a social lobby space with a cafe.
cards.short_summary: Brown's primary indoor athletic and fitness facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nelson Fitness Center features a 10,000 square foot fitness loft and is open on weekends from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Nelson Fitness Center - Brown University Recreation
cards.access_notes: Brown ID required for entry; weekend hours are 8:00 AM - 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Find Your Study Nook at 'The Rock'
cards.subtitle: The Main Humanities and Social Sciences Library
cards.notes: Explore the stacks and find a quiet place to read. The first floor offers digital studios, while upper floors provide classic library silence and views of the city.
cards.short_summary: The primary research library for humanities and social sciences at Brown.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rockefeller Library, known as 'the Rock,' is the primary teaching and research library for humanities and social sciences.
cards.access_notes: Brown ID swipe access required; weekend hours typically start at 10:00 AM or 12:00 PM.

cards.title: Discover the Innovation Hub
cards.subtitle: Workshops and Community for New Ideas
cards.notes: Stop by the Nelson Center to learn about the 'Innovation Dojo' for first-years. It is a collaborative space for students looking to develop new ventures.
cards.short_summary: A hub for interdisciplinary entrepreneurship and student-led ventures.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nelson Center offers the Innovation Dojo, a workshop specifically for first- and second-year students to develop ventures.
cards.access_notes: Open to students for workshops and collaborative work; check calendar for specific events.

cards.title: Explore the Activities Fair
cards.subtitle: Connect with 450+ Student Groups
cards.notes: Walk through the rows of tables on the Main Green to find your community. From club sports to a capella, this is the best way to see the breadth of campus life.
cards.short_summary: The annual fair where student organizations recruit new members.
cards.evidence_claim: The annual Fall Student Activities Fair takes place on the Main Green, featuring recognized student organizations.
cards.source_title: Fall 2025 Student Activities Fair | Events | Brown University
cards.access_notes: Typically held on the first Thursday or Friday of the semester; open to all students.
